[numthreads(8, 8, 1)]
void main(uint2 pixel : SV_DispatchThreadID)
{
    RayDesc ray;
    ray.Origin = float3(pixel.x, pixel.y, 0);
    ray.TMin = 0;
    ray.TMax = 1000;
    ray.Direction = float3(0, 1, 0);

    rayQuery.Proceed();

    if (rayQuery.CommittedStatus() == COMMITTED_TRIANGLE_HIT)

    else
        u_Output[pixel] = 0;
}
